Looking for somewhere cosy? Here are our picks.

1. Tiong Bahru Bakery

Flaky croissants and a quiet corner make this a classic date spot. The kouign amann is a must.

Address: 56 Eng Hoon Street, #01-70, Singapore 160056
Opening Hours: 7.30am to 8pm daily
Tel: +65 6220 3430
